SELECT
  a.Z_PK,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  a.ZTRASHEDSTATE,
  a.ZHIDDEN,
  a.ZFAVORITE,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMAKE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMODEL
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZTIMEZONEOFFSET
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  a.ZSAVEDASSETTYPE
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  COUNT(*) AS antal,
  datetime(MIN(a.ZADDEDDATE) + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS forst_tillagd,
  datetime(MAX(a.ZADDEDDATE) + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS senast_tillagd
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
GROUP BY aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
ORDER BY antal DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE IFNULL(aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  ext.ZCAMERAMAKE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMODEL,
  ext.ZLENSMODEL,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  ext.ZLATITUDE AS EXT_ZLATITUDE,
  ext.ZLONGITUDE AS EXT_ZLONGITUDE
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZLATITUDE IS NOT NULL
  AND a.ZLATITUDE != -180
  AND a.ZDATECREATED BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE DESC;

SELECT
  datetime(u.ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  u.ZEDITORLOCALIZEDNAME,
  u.ZADJUSTMENTFORMATIDENTIFIER,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT u ON u.Z_PK = aa.ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT
WHERE aa.ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT > 0
ORDER BY u.ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  a.ZHIDDEN,
  a.ZTRASHEDSTATE,
  datetime(a.ZTRASHEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZTRASHEDDATE,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZHIDDEN = 1
   OR a.ZTRASHEDSTATE = 1
ORDER BY a.ZTRASHEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  g.Z_PK,
  g.ZTITLE,
  g.ZKIND,
  g.ZCACHEDCOUNT,
  datetime(g.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  g.ZTRASHEDSTATE
FROM ZGENERICALBUM g
WHERE g.ZTITLE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.ZCREATIONDATE DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  cm.ZORIGINALFILENAME AS CLOUD_ZORIGINALFILENAME
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZCLOUDMASTER cm ON cm.Z_PK = a.ZMASTER
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDIRECTORY, a.ZFILENAME;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  a.ZSAVEDASSETTYPE,
  cm.ZCLOUDLOCALSTATE AS CLOUD_ZCLOUDLOCALSTATE,
  datetime(cm.ZIMPORTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS CLOUD_ZIMPORTDATE
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZCLOUDMASTER cm ON cm.Z_PK = a.ZMASTER
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZFILENAME;

SELECT name, type
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type = 'table'
  AND name LIKE 'Z%'
ORDER BY name;

PRAGMA table_info(ZGENERICASSET);
PRAGMA table_info(ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES);

SELECT m.name AS tabell, group_concat(p.name, ', ') AS kolumner
FROM sqlite_master m, pragma_table_info(m.name) p
WHERE m.type = 'table'
  AND m.name GLOB 'Z_[0-9]*ASSETS'
GROUP BY m.name
ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT
  a.Z_PK,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,

LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES

WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZTIMEZONEOFFSET
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZIMPORTEDBYDISPLAYNAME,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,

FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  MAX(aa.ZIMPORTEDBYDISPLAYNAME) AS ZIMPORTEDBYDISPLAYNAME,
  COUNT(*) AS antal,
  datetime(MIN(a.ZADDEDDATE) + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS forst_tillagd,
  datetime(MAX(a.ZADDEDDATE) + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS senast_tillagd
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
GROUP BY aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
ORDER BY antal DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE IFNULL(aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  ext.ZCAMERAMAKE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMODEL,
  ext.ZLENSMODEL,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  ext.ZLATITUDE AS EXT_ZLATITUDE,
  ext.ZLONGITUDE AS EXT_ZLONGITUDE
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZLATITUDE IS NOT NULL
  AND a.ZLATITUDE != -180
  AND a.ZDATECREATED BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  CASE a.ZKINDSUBTYPE WHEN 10 THEN 'Skärmdump' WHEN 103 THEN 'Skärminspelning' END AS typ,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZKINDSUBTYPE IN (10, 103)
  AND a.ZDATECREATED BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE DESC;

SELECT
  datetime(u.ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  u.ZEDITORLOCALIZEDNAME,
  u.ZADJUSTMENTFORMATIDENTIFIER,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT u ON u.Z_PK = aa.ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT
WHERE aa.ZUNMANAGEDADJUSTMENT > 0
ORDER BY u.ZADJUSTMENTTIMESTAMP DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  a.ZHIDDEN,
  a.ZTRASHEDSTATE,
  datetime(a.ZTRASHEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZTRASHEDDATE,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZHIDDEN = 1
   OR a.ZTRASHEDSTATE = 1
ORDER BY a.ZTRASHEDDATE DESC;

SELECT
  a.ZFILENAME,
  p.ZFULLNAME,
  p.ZDISPLAYNAME,
  f.ZMANUAL,
  f.ZHIDDEN
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
INNER JOIN ZDETECTEDFACE f ON f.ZASSET = a.Z_PK
LEFT JOIN ZPERSON p ON p.Z_PK = f.ZPERSON
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZFILENAME;

SELECT
  p.ZFULLNAME,
  p.ZDISPLAYNAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME
FROM ZASSET a
INNER JOIN ZDETECTEDFACE f ON f.ZASSET = a.Z_PK
INNER JOIN ZPERSON p ON p.Z_PK = f.ZPERSON
WHERE IFNULL(p.ZFULLNAME, '') LIKE '%{{person}}%'
   OR IFNULL(p.ZDISPLAYNAME, '') LIKE '%{{person}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZDATECREATED;

SELECT
  g.Z_PK,
  g.ZTITLE,
  g.ZKIND,
  g.ZCACHEDCOUNT,
  datetime(g.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  g.ZTRASHEDSTATE
FROM ZGENERICALBUM g
WHERE g.ZTITLE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.ZCREATIONDATE DESC;

SELECT

SELECT

  a.ZCLOUDLOCALSTATE,
  a.ZCLOUDASSETGUID,
  a.ZSAVEDASSETTYPE,
  cm.ZCLOUDLOCALSTATE AS CLOUD_ZCLOUDLOCALSTATE,
  datetime(cm.ZIMPORTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS CLOUD_ZIMPORTDATE
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.Z_PK = a.ZADDITIONALATTRIBUTES
LEFT JOIN ZCLOUDMASTER cm ON cm.Z_PK = a.ZMASTER
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'

SELECT name, type
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type = 'table'
  AND name LIKE 'Z%'
ORDER BY name;

PRAGMA table_info(ZASSET);
PRAGMA table_info(ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES);

FROM sqlite_master m, pragma_table_info(m.name) p
WHERE m.type = 'table'
  AND m.name GLOB 'Z_[0-9]*ASSETS'
GROUP BY m.name
ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT
  a.Z_PK,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZIMPORTEDBYDISPLAYNAME,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  a.ZKIND,
  a.ZKINDSUBTYPE,
  a.ZTRASHEDSTATE,
  a.ZHIDDEN,
  a.ZFAVORITE,

  a.ZLATITUDE,

FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.ZASSET = a.Z_PK

  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZDATECREATED,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZMODIFICATIONDATE,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZADDEDDATE,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING,
  aa.ZTIMEZONENAME,
  aa.ZIMPORTEDBYBUNDLEIDENTIFIER,
  aa.ZIMPORTEDBYDISPLAYNAME,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  a.ZKIND,
  a.ZKINDSUBTYPE,
  a.ZTRASHEDSTATE,
  a.ZHIDDEN,
  a.ZFAVORITE,
  a.ZUNIFORMTYPEIDENTIFIER,
  a.ZLATITUDE,
  a.ZLONGITUDE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMAKE,
  ext.ZCAMERAMODEL
FROM ZASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.ZASSET = a.Z_PK
LEFT JOIN ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES ext ON ext.Z_PK = a.ZEXTENDEDATTRIBUTES
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

paramLabels.filename: Filnamn eller del av filnamn (komma-separerade om flera)
